patch_description: Backfill cost=None edges with a finite penalty (1e6) so Dijkstra can't crash on None comparisons and so unknown-cost links are naturally deprioritized. Then compute candidate paths per destination (shortest path plus a few k-shortest alternatives) and rotate partitions across them to spread load across networks/parallel routes, reducing redundant transfers over expensive links. Dijkstra is run once per source; candidates come from shortest_simple_paths with early termination for efficiency.
